description_en: Query session connection information for a cluster
description_zh: 查询某集群的会话连接信息
kebab_example: aliyun gws describe-cluster-connections --cluster-id gws-xxx --start-time 2020-09-07 --end-time 2020-09-01 --task-id t-xxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeClusterConnections

parameters.help_en: The start date of the query interval
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end date of the query interval
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The task ID for asynchronous queries
parameters.help_zh: 做异步查询时的 task id
parameters.name: task_id

Connections.description_en: An array describing connection session information
Connections.description_zh: 描述连接会话信息的数组

ClientName.description_en: The host name of the client

LogoffStatus.description_en:
0: The session has exited normally.
Empty value: The session has not exited yet
LogoffStatus.description_zh:
0：此会话已正常退出
空值：此会话还未退出

LogoffTime.description_en:
The logoff time of this session.
When this value is empty, it indicates that the session has not exited yet
LogoffTime.description_zh:
此会话的退出时间。
当此值为空时，说明此会话还未退出

LogonTime.description_en: The logon time of this session

TaskFinished.description_en:
true: The current task has been completed.
false: The current task is still running
TaskFinished.description_zh:
true：当前 task 已经完成
false：当前 task 还在运行中

TaskId.description_en:
If the TaskId input parameter is empty when calling, the caller needs to use the TaskId in the return value to continue calling this API to obtain the query result.
If the TaskId input parameter is not empty when calling, the return value will query the running status of this TaskId
TaskId.description_zh:
调用时如果入参TaskId为空，则调用方需使用返回值中的TaskId，继续调用此API来获得查询命令的结果。
调用时如果入参TaskId非空，则返回值会查询此TaskId 的运行状态

TotalCount.description_en: The length of the Connections array
